# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 79 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 79

A woman from the crowd said to him: "Blessed is the womb that bore you and the breasts that nourished you." He said to her: "Blessed are those who have heard the word of the Father and have truly kept it. For there will be days when you will say: 'Blessed is the womb that has not conceived and the breasts that have not given milk.'"

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- The first beatitude parallels Luke 11:27-28; the second parallels Luke 23:29
- Thomas joins two sayings that are separate in Luke; this is a distinctive Thomasine combination
- "Blessed is the womb that bore you" — the woman's praise for Mary (unnamed); Jesus redirects to hearing the word
- "The womb that has not conceived" — the eschatological reversal: in coming tribulation, barrenness is a blessing
- This creates a double reframing: (1) physical maternity < hearing the word; (2) future barrenness > current fertility
